card.name: Number just before cents or percent
card.fires_on: The spot right before a number's digits or a small-amount word, where a unit such as cents, percent or a decimal place comes next. Seen mostly in price (cents per kWh) and percent-change text.

modes.label: Cents per kWh prices
modes.description: The gap or first digit before a price in cents, in solar power price text.
modes.example: It fell to 24 euro cents per kWh for new plants in 2012 from<< >>57 cents in 200

modes.label: Percent changes
modes.description: The gap before a number that will be followed by a percent sign, in lab-result text.
modes.example: The mean minimum lithium concentration increased<< >>15%, and the renal clearance decreased

modes.label: Small amount words
modes.description: A quantity word like few before cents.
modes.example: solar now generates electricity at levels only a<< few>> cents above what consumers pay.
